【通用属性规范】\n以下为脚本节点属性，属性中的“必填”表示生成可运行节点所需条:
[General attribute specifications]
The following are script node attributes. "Required" in the attributes indicates the conditions required to generate a runnable node; "Interface initial value" does not mean that the field can be omitted. Required parameters that do not have a default value must be filled in explicitly. The example is a node configuration fragment. The example ID, package name, positioning, variable, material and uppercase reference ID must be replaced with real information and accompanied by the referenced node or script; the example node cannot be mixed into the current recording process.

| Properties | Types and Requirements | Meaning and Default Behavior |
| --- | --- | --- |
| id | string, required, unique in the same script | A stable identifier that is referenced by branches, loops, and pairs, and must be referenced synchronously if the name is changed |
| type | string, required | Use the real node type listed below; the menu shortcut name is not type |
| label | string, required | Human-readable name, used for display and logging; does not replace positioning or business assertions |
| note | string, optional | User business notes, not executable instructions |
| selector | AppiumSelector, the condition is required | The node that requires component positioning must be provided; coordinate click uses fallback |
| contextSelector | AppiumSelector, optional | Restrict targeting to inside matching parent components |
| selectorChain | AppiumSelector[], optional | Save the backup positioning chain, the original positioning cannot be deleted without authorization |
| fallback | AppiumSelector, optional or conditionally required | Support click/long press of alternate coordinates using bounds+centerX/centerY, which does not mean that all nodes support coordinate downgrade |
| timeoutMs | number, optional, unit ms | The meaning is determined by the node type; the default is 3000 for regular positioning wait, the default delay is 1000, the default is 800 for long press, AI needs to enable timeout first |
| timeoutBranch | stop/yes/no, optional | Determine timeout processing, omit pressing stop; not a unified cover for any exception |
| flow | object, optional or required for branches | nodeKind, branch entry, success/failure successor, branch ownership and textMatch, see process connection rules for details |
| flow.collapsed | boolean, optional | Editor collapsed display status, does not affect operation |
| snapshot | {text,resourceId,contentDesc,className}, optional | Record component summary to assist understanding, does not replace selector |
| pageBefore/pageAfter | {activity?,packageName?,treeSignature?,selectedNodePath?}, optional | Page context; treeSignature is a summary, not a complete component tree, and new positioning cannot be fabricated based on it |
| mergeUndo | Editor internal data | Not generated or restored, export removed |

AppiumSelector: strategy is required and is accessibilityId/id/androidUiAutomator/xpath/bounds; the first four use non-empty string value, and bounds uses limited number centerX/centerY. unique?:boolean, matchCount?:number, source?:"node"|"ancestor"|"fallback" are collection metadata, and uniqueness must not be forged; coordinates and areas are device pixels, not browser CSS coordinates.
flow.nodeKind must be filled in according to the real node purpose; do not change the normal operation to condition for supplementary connections, otherwise the actual execution behavior may be changed. Nodes fixed as conditions or operations are subject to their type rules.
Variable: TestVariable={name:string,value:string,sensitive?:boolean}; name starts with a letter or underscore, contains only alphanumeric underscores, and can be up to 80 characters; value is a text of up to 20,000 characters, and a single variable list can have up to 200 items, and the name cannot be repeated. Sensitive names such as passwords and tokens are automatically marked as sensitive. {{Variable name}} will fail if it is undefined or has a circular reference, and the child script will not automatically inherit the private variables of the parent script.

[Positioning selection and information missing processing when the control ID is unknown]
First, distinguish between two types of IDs: steps[].id is the process node ID, which can be generated by itself. Only the connection reference is maintained uniquely and synchronously; the component resource-id/resourceId is the real control attribute of the target App. When selector.strategy="id", the selector.value must come from the actual collection, and a control ID cannot be spelled out based on the node name, package name or business purpose.

Select the positioning method based on existing evidence. The lack of a control ID does not mean that coordinates must be used:
1. The recorded node will first retain the existing selector, contextSelector and selectorChain. When adding new targets, first use the real recording positioning or the component tree of the current page; when there is a device accessing the tool, it is first collected and then generated; when there is no tool, the required information is explicitly requested and the device is not claimed to have been read.
2. Use id when a real and stable resource-id is known; use accessibilityId when there is no resource-id but the component has a real content-desc/accessibility description and can be uniquely located. Do not automatically treat display text or business notes as content-desc, and do not set unique=true or matchCount=1 without justification.
3. When the target action is click and the accessible native text has been confirmed, you can use textClick+value, giving priority to exact matching. textClick is a branch node. When converting existing clicks, matching, unmatched and timeout paths must be maintained at the same time. The original failed stop behavior cannot be changed to skip without authorization. Operations such as inputting, clearing, and extracting attributes still require a real component selector and cannot be replaced by textClick.
4. When there is a real component tree, you can select androidUiAutomator or XPath based on the actual text, content-desc, class and other attributes. Duplicate text or multiple identical IDs should be combined with the real parent component contextSelector and other distinguishing properties; no guessing at levels, child node numbers, or randomly selecting the first match. Screenshots alone cannot reveal XPath, resource-id, native class, or node index; the text in the screenshot is not guaranteed to exist in the native component tree.
5. Only when taking a screenshot, first confirm the device screenshot size, direction, zoom and target position; only use fallback={strategy:"bounds",centerX,centerY} of coordinateTap, or long press with explicit longPressMode="coordinates" when there is a clear pixel position and the action supports coordinates. Coordinates cannot be copied directly from browser screenshots, nor can they be guessed based on descriptions such as "the upper right corner of the page"; they need to be reconfirmed after changing devices or changing the layout. Input and other required component actions cannot be bypassed by fictitious coordinate positioning. imageCheck is used for image condition, not picture clicking actions. The template must also come from real collection.

When positioning information is insufficient, you must:
- Do not make up control ID, accessibilityId, XPath, UiAutomator attribute conditions or coordinates; com.example:id/target, etc. in the reference example are only format demonstrations and cannot be used as the real locator of the target App.
- List of "positioning information to be supplemented": node ID/name, operation type, target page and component description, existing evidence, missing positioning attributes, recommended component tree XML/recording positioning/device screenshot and size. The information already provided will be reused directly and will not be requested again.
- You can provide a process draft that is clearly marked "not directly runnable" and mark the positioning to be completed in the notes or list; do not fill in TODO, guessed values or sample IDs as real selectors and then claim that they are runnable, and do not use noops, empty selectors, ignore failures or delete nodes to pretend to complete the original operation. Before the real positioning and branch connection are completed, it will not be declared that the script is available or has been played back.
Collection suggestions: Connect the device → Enter the target page → Refresh the App component tree → Select the target in the device preview or component tree → Record the operation → Then copy to LLM. The current export contains the positioning and summary of the recorded nodes. It is not guaranteed to contain the complete component tree or screenshot of the target page, and it cannot be inferred that the unrecorded controls are not included.

[Image configuration properties]
All modes of ImageCheckConfig should retain the complete configuration object; the following initial values can be created by the interface, but should be filled in explicitly when generated and do not rely on automatic completion by import:
- mode: required template/state/black/color/change. template does template matching; state compares the selected and unselected templates; black checks the black screen; color checks the color ratio; change checks multi-frame changes.
- target: required region/element; region={x,y,width,height} is a required pixel area, x/y is an integer from 0 to 16000, and width/height is an integer from 1 to 16000. When target=region, screenWidth/screenHeight is required and is an integer from 1 to 16000 and conforms to the real acquisition screen; when target=element, the component selector is also required.
- template: PNG Base64 required for template/state mode; negativeTemplate: unselected template must also be provided for state mode. Each image is less than 3MB, and the template cannot be larger than the detection area; file paths or any placeholder text are not accepted as real templates.
- expectation: required present/absent, initial present; template means expected matching/not matched, change means expected change/no obvious change; state's true means selected, false means unselected, and will not be flipped by this field.
- threshold: template threshold 0.01~1, initial 0.9; minScoreGap: minimum score difference between two state templates 0.001~1, initial 0.1.
- color: #RRGGBB, initial #000000; tolerance: integer 0~255, initial 30; ratio: percentage 0.01~100, initial 95, not 0.95.
- durationMs: observation duration integer 0~60000 ms, initial 3000; intervalMs: sampling interval integer 200~10000 ms, initial 1000; consecutive: continuous satisfying frame number integer 1~100, initial 1, cannot exceed floor(durationMs/intervalMs)+1. The durationMs of change mode must be no less than intervalMs.

【How to add, edit and connect nodes】
When generating JSON: First clarify the business action and real goal, select type → fill in attributes by type → set branch ownership and reference → check connections and dependencies → generate complete imported JSON. New nodes use new IDs, and edited nodes retain unchanged fields; copying nodes requires creating a new ID and synchronously copying references within the scope; deleting a node requires revising all entries, belongings, successors, and pairing references pointing to it, and no dangling targets are allowed.
When you need to operate the Qualix interface: first select the device and app, and for component operation, first select the target component → click "+" in the expected insertion position or branch to select the operation → fill in the parameters → click the node card or the dedicated editing entrance to modify → check the branches on both sides and the common confluence path → save and play back. The "+" within the branch determines the ownership, and the public path uses the merge branch function or the correct subsequent reference; do not assume that you can drag a line at will to replace the execution configuration.
Menu mapping: system return/Home/recent tasks/power are all saved as key+corresponding keyCode; condition of existence is saved as assertExists+flow.nodeKind="condition"; start/end screen changes are saved as visualChange, distinguished by role and pairing ID. When generating scripts, do not use menu shortcut names such as keyBack, keyHome, popupCondition, visualChangeStart, etc. as type.
使用 OpenCV 在本地判断指定区域，不调用 AI。适合固定图标、图片勾选状态: Use OpenCV to determine the specified area locally without calling AI. It is suitable for fixed icons, picture check states, black screens, colors and multi-frame changes; it is not suitable for business semantics or arbitrary text recognition, and it cannot prove that buttons are available or the video is stuck based on appearance alone. When native attributes can be read, attribute condition is used first. Insufficient evidence reports that the condition cannot be made.
记录点击当前选中的组件，回放时重新定位后点击。: Record clicks on the currently selected component, and reposition and click during playback.
向当前选中的输入组件写入指定文字，支持 {{变量名}} 引用。: Writes the specified text to the currently selected input component, and supports {{variable name}} reference.
读取组件文字或属性，保存到当前脚本变量供后续节点引用。: Read component text or attributes and save them to current script variables for reference by subsequent nodes.
从预设文本或导入的 TXT 中抽取一条，或生成随机整数、UUID，写入脚本变量。: Extract a piece of preset text or imported TXT, or generate a random integer or UUID and write it into a script variable. It is extracted once every time and can be re-valued every round if placed in the loop body.
通用计时：通过系统生成的计时器 ID 关联开始、打点和结束节点，名称仅用于显示；: Universal timing: associate start, tick, and end nodes through system-generated timer IDs, names are for display only; log output absolute time, milliseconds from start and last tick. In conjunction with the waiting node, processes such as page loading, interface return, or chat response can be measured.
清空当前选中输入组件的内容。: Clear the contents of the currently selected input component.
点击设备屏幕上的指定 X、Y 坐标。节点中可修改坐标，页面位置变化后需重新确认。: Click the specified X,Y coordinate on the device screen. The coordinates can be modified in the node, and you need to reconfirm after the page position changes.
长按指定元素或屏幕坐标，可设置按住时长，默认按元素定位。: Long press the specified element or screen coordinates, you can set the holding time, and the default positioning is based on the element.
按 Home 键返回设备桌面，不等同于关闭应用。: Pressing the Home key to return to the device desktop is not the same as closing the app.
发送电源键操作，实际锁屏或唤醒行为由设备当前状态决定。: Send the power key operation, the actual lock screen or wake up behavior is determined by the current state of the device.
按指定起点、终点和时长滑动屏幕。: Slide the screen by specifying the starting point, end point and duration.
执行双指放大或缩小手势，需要当前页面支持缩放。: To perform a two-finger zoom-in or zoom-out gesture, the current page needs to support zooming.
启动指定应用，可放在流程中途或分支中执行。: Start the specified application, which can be executed in the middle of the process or in a branch.

打开设备相册应用，不自动选择照片或视频。: Open the device photo album app without automatically selecting photos or videos.
立即结束当前回放流程，后续节点不再执行。: End the current playback process immediately, and subsequent nodes will not be executed.
重复执行循环体，支持固定次数或条件退出，必须设置最大次数。: Repeat the execution of the loop body, supporting a fixed number of times or conditional exit, and the maximum number of times must be set.
退出指定的当前或外层循环，继续执行该循环的结束路径。: Exit the specified current or outer loop and continue execution of the loop's end path.

selector.strategy accepts accessibilityId, id, androidUiAutomator, xpath and bounds. Non-coordinate locators use value; coordinate locators use centerX/centerY. contextSelector scopes the parent component, selectorChain supplies alternate locators, and fallback supplies alternate coordinates. Preserve component locators instead of replacing them with coordinates. Coordinates, swipe paths and image regions depend on the captured screen size and layout; verify them when changing devices.
The meaning of value depends on type: input text, expected text, Activity, app package, AI prompt or child script ID. timeoutMs is in milliseconds. Ordinary nodes default to {1} ms; long-press and AI-observation durations use their own settings. Do not replace these behaviors with sleep.

[Flow connections]
Connections belong in steps[].flow. A node list or canvas screenshot is insufficient. flow.nodeKind is action/condition/assertion. yesTargetId/noTargetId identify branch entries, successTargetId is an explicit successful successor, and failureTargetId handles ordinary action or assertion failures. Store parentConditionId/parentBranch together to identify the owning condition and its yes/no branch. textMatch is contains/exact.
Without an explicit successor, an ordinary node runs the immediately following array entry only if it has the same branch ownership; otherwise execution returns to the owning condition's shared continuation. A condition without an explicit shared successor may continue with a later node in the same scope. Empty branches follow the shared continuation. Omitting successTargetId from an ordinary node does not necessarily disconnect it.
When creating branches, point yesTargetId/noTargetId to their first nodes and set matching parentConditionId/parentBranch on the branch nodes. Both sets are required. Converging branches must share the same continuation node and retain necessary successTargetId links. Do not duplicate similar, disconnected continuation nodes for the two branches.
A type="loop" node uses loop={maxIterations:1..10000,exitWhen:"never"|"exists"|"notExists"}. The yes branch is the loop body; no is the exit path. Check exit conditions before each iteration and exit normally at the iteration limit. The body returns to its loop automatically. Do not add ordinary backward edges or connect the body to an unrelated branch to fill a missing connection. breakLoopTargetId/continueLoopTargetId may reference only a loop enclosing the current node.
timeoutBranch="stop"|"yes"|"no" determines condition-timeout behavior. aiInvalidResultBranch determines the branch used when AI produces no valid result. Do not map every exception to false. endFlow ends the entire replay, including callers. A child script that finishes normally returns to its caller's continuation.
Verify unique IDs; existing targets, owners, loops and paired references; no unintended self-loops or ordinary backward edges; consistent branch entries and ownership; correct shared continuations; reachable required nodes; and valid endpoints. Update every reference when changing an ID. Never hide errors by deleting connection fields. The connection inventory below includes implicit continuations and virtual loop returns for verification; it is not a separate edges field to save.
